product.name: Qalam-Sense
product.tagline: Reading that adapts to every child, in Arabic and French
product.audience: Teachers and parents of children with reading difficulties; internship interviewers
valueProps: An ordinary webcam follows reading, entirely on the device
The text adapts gently when reading becomes effortful
Teachers see what changed and why

voice.note: The current audio files were made offline with the built-in Windows voice (Microsoft Zira) by tts-windows.mjs, because the fal.ai account had no credit. Run gen/tts.mjs --all --force to replace them with this AI voice.

timeline.title: Every child reads differently
timeline.subtitle: Qalam-Sense · Arabic & French
timeline.narration: Every child reads differently. In a class of thirty, the ones who struggle often go unseen.
timeline.note: Hook: the problem, before the product.

timeline.narration: A teacher adds a student in seconds. The app creates a login, a PIN, and a one-time code for the parent.
timeline.note: Fictional teacher adds a fictional student, Lina.

timeline.narration: With a parent's consent, an ordinary webcam follows the reader. A short star game calibrates it.
timeline.note: Star calibration game. Gaze comes from the simulated reader.

timeline.narration: When reading gets harder, the text adapts. Larger letters, more space, calmer colours. Gently, and the child can always undo it.
timeline.note: Simulated reader becomes effortful; the engine raises support on camera.

timeline.narration: Teachers see what happened, and why. Every change comes with its reasons, and the passages that took the most effort.
timeline.note: Teacher report for a session produced by the real pipeline on a simulated reader.

timeline.title: Private by design
timeline.subtitle: Runs entirely on the device · reading scenes use a simulated reader
timeline.narration: Everything runs on the device. No image is ever stored. Qalam-Sense: reading that adapts.
